en: Q3 returned to growth: revenue 235.938M and EBIT 47.742M both exceeded the prior year. This supports observation, not purchase approval.

es: El EBIT y EPS TTM siguen cayendo. 37South, anunciada como adquirida el 3 de noviembre, queda fuera del modelo por términos financieros no divulgados. La valoración combinada permanece pendiente.
en: Trailing EBIT and EPS are still declining. 37South, announced as acquired on November 3, is outside the model because financial terms were not disclosed. Combined valuation remains pending.
